steps: Drop demo music at 0.35 s, stem at 2 s, sfx at 4 s (5M: also click music clip, Ctrl+D x2)
Tab to the format radio; keep WAV or ArrowDown to MP3
Tab to the export button, press Enter
During the render press Tab three times
bugs.expected: Focus stays inside the Export dialog during the render (PX-KEYS-R, FOCUS-NOT-OBSCURED)
bugs.actual: Tab1 -> X, Tab2 -> checked format radio, Tab3 -> BODY, Tab4 -> arrangement-exit (page link behind modal), then Master Mute/Volume. Happens with WAV (default) and MP3 checked, at both viewports, incl. the round-87 range recipe; with WAV+MP3 checked the trap wraps to X. Pre-existing: trap code byte-identical to round-87 snapshot; not caused by F1/F2. Inferred cause: during render only X + format radios are enabled, trap wraps only when active===last (format-both), native Tab treats the radio group as one stop. Round-87 PX-KEYS passed because it ran after earlier MP3 exports in the same session (encoder cached), so the short range render had finished by Tab 3 (scope-range focusable only when isRendering is false); C's V1 reruns the same recipe as the first MP3 of the session, the load phase keeps the render alive and Tab 3 escapes. Consequence: with default settings a keyboard user reaches arrangement-exit (navigation away) and Master Mute/Volume behind a busy modal mid-export; Space/Enter there acts on the workspace.
